body:
@kamami
FYI, I have downgraded Algoliasearch to version 4.24.0, and it's now working. The problem seems to be with version 5 of Algoliasearch. That said, this does not resolve the underlying issues, but it is a workaround to avoid the error.

I have also changed this => `import { liteClient as algoliasearch } from algoliasearch/lite;`
By this => `import algoliasearch from algoliasearch/lite;`
